**accesskey on
** _HTML attribute_ ```typescript accessKey: HTMLElementTagNameMap["div"]["accessKey"] ``` Native DOM attribute recognized by the Vue template compiler. Vue patches it on the platform element rather than resolving it as a component prop. **Runtime surface** DOM reflected attribute **Editor behavior** - Hover and go-to-definition use the DOM library type for the reflected property when the type service is available. - Component prop lookup is skipped because the enclosing tag is a native element. **Example** ```vue ``` **Docs** [MDN reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Global_attributes/accesskey)
